entries.title: Psalms 84:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician; set to the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.>> How  amiable are thy tabernacles, O Jehovah of hosts!

entries.title: Psalms 84:2
segments: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Jehovah; My heart and my flesh  cry out unto the living God.

entries.title: Psalms 84:3
segments: Yea, the sparrow hath found her a house, And the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, Even thine altars, O Jehovah of hosts, My King, and my God.

entries.title: Psalms 84:4
segments: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: They will be still praising thee. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 84:5
segments: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; In whose heart are the highways [to Zion].

entries.title: Psalms 84:6
segments: Passing through the valley of  Weeping they make it a place of springs; Yea, the early rain covereth it with blessings.

entries.title: Psalms 84:7
segments: They go from strength to strength; Every one of them appeareth before God in Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 84:8
segments: O Jehovah God of hosts, hear my prayer; Give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 84:9
segments: Behold, O God our shield, And look upon the face of thine anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 84:10
segments: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather  be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, Than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

entries.title: Psalms 84:11
segments: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield: Jehovah will give grace and glory; No good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

entries.title: Psalms 84:12
segments: O Jehovah of hosts, Blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.
